عَلِيثٌ Bread made of barley and wheat: (S, O, K:) and so غَلِيثٌ. (S, O.) And خَمِيرٌ عَلِيثٌ Bread made of barley and [the grain called] سُلْت. (TA, from a trad.) ―
-b2- And Wheat mixed with barley; (AZ, TA;) as also ↓ عَلَثٌ and ↓ عَلِيثَةٌ : or, accord. to Abu-l-Jarráh, barley and wheat mixed together for sowing and then reaped together. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
